2x.superseded: was checkpoints_c16/webcodec_2x_c16.pth; swapped after RESEARCH.md 34 — perc drops the fidelity-only phase 1 so every epoch carries the perceptual term. Beats the previous weights at t=5.36 on 18/19 clips and is the first model here to beat bicubic on 19/19 (+5.8% -> +7.1%).

_note: Which checkpoint each shipped .bin was exported from. The .bin files are tracked in git and the .pth files are not, so without this record the two drift silently -- they already did once, and two sessions of evaluation scored a model users do not run. Verify with training/eval/verify_shipped.py before reporting any "shipped" number.

2x_lite.note: Lite tier (RESEARCH.md 35): 8 channels + anchor skip, 8,956 params, ~3.3x cheaper than 2x. Used when the 2x model cannot keep up, and by default on Battery. +5.5% camera DISTS vs bicubic, 19/19 clips.
